tools.name: fs_read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

Usage:
- The file_path parameter must be an absolute path, not a relative path.
- By default, it reads from the beginning of the file.
- You can optionally specify offset and limit for long files.
- This tool can read images, Jupyter notebooks, and PDF files.
- For PDFs over 10 pages, you must provide the pages parameter.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

limit.description: The number of lines to read. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

pages.description: Page range for PDF files (e.g., "1-5", "3", "10-20"). Maximum 20 pages per request.

tools.name: fs_edit
tools.description: Modify file contents in place using old_string/new_string replacement.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to modify

new_string.description: The text to replace it with

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false)

tools.name: fs_write
tools.description:
Writes a file to the local filesystem.

Usage:
- This tool will overwrite the existing file if there is one at the provided path.
- Prefer fs_edit for modifying existing files and fs_write for creation or complete rewrites.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to write

content.description: The content to write to the file

tools.name: fs_glob
tools.description:
Fast file pattern matching tool.

Usage:
- Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts".
- Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.
- Use this tool when you need to find files by name patterns.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, the current working directory will be used.

tools.name: fs_grep
tools.description:
A powerful search tool built on ripgrep.

Usage:
- Supports full regex syntax.
- Filter files with glob or type.
- Output modes: content, files_with_matches, count.
- Use multiline: true for cross-line matches.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in. Defaults to current working directory.

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output. Defaults to true for content mode.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries. Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited.

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit.
